items.difficulty_reason: 11 行、对角作用的张量保持投射性：Hom-tensor 伴随（共轭作用）把问题化为一串正合函子的复合——P 投射给 Hom_{A[G]}(P,-) 正合、M 投射给 Hom_Λ(M,-) 正合；正合即投射。承重两步都在 span 内；无外部引用。

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: compute Hom out of the tensor product with the diagonal action as Hom out of P into the conjugation G-module Hom(M, N), an exact functor in N composed of exact pieces because P and M are projective (source lines 1703-1713)
